task.name: validate-code
task.description: Check code for Frappe anti-patterns and quality issues

steps.step: Check imports: Verify frappe.utils used for dates/numbers
Check SQL: Verify all queries use parameterization
Check permissions: Verify all @frappe.whitelist() have checks
Check UI: Verify frappe.ui components used (not custom HTML/CSS)
Check naming: Verify descriptive function/variable names

anti_patterns.pattern: String concatenation in SQL queries (SQL injection risk)
Custom HTML/CSS instead of frappe.ui components

quality_checks.check: Code is self-documenting with descriptive names
Business logic in Python, not JavaScript
Helper functions only when used 3+ times
